title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents
abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly embedded in software engineering workflows as coding agents that can inspect repositories, invoke tools, execute tests, debug failures, and generate patches. Yet most existing agents remain largely static after deployment, even though software development is a dynamic, feedback-rich process in which repositories evolve, dependencies change, tests fail, and repair attempts leave reusable experience. This tension has motivated a growing body of work on self-evolving coding agents, where the agent improves its future behavior by updating its framework, memory, skills, tools, models, or collaboration structures from prior coding interactions. In this survey, we provide a systematic synthesis of this emerging area. We first define self-evolving coding agents and distinguish them from conventional coding agents and general self-evolving agents. We then develop an object-centered taxonomy that characterizes what evolves in these systems, and complement it with two orthogonal perspectives: when evolution occurs and what software-specific evidence drives it. Across the literature, we find that executable feedback, repository-level context, and coding trajectories give software engineering a distinctive role as a natural domain for agent self-evolution, but also introduce new challenges in feedback reliability, benchmark overfitting, safety, maintainability, cost, and generalization. By organizing existing work around these dimensions, this survey aims to clarify the conceptual boundaries of self-evolving coding agents and provide a foundation for designing more adaptive, reliable, and software-aware agentic systems. The papers we collect can be found at https://github.com/zhouhao1024/Awesome-Self-Evolving-Coding-Agents.
abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型越来越多地嵌入软件工程流程，coding agents 已能检查代码仓库、调用工具、执行测试、调试失败并生成补丁。然而，现有大多数智能体在部署后仍相对静态，而真实软件开发过程却充满动态反馈：仓库持续演化、依赖不断变化、测试可能失败、修复尝试会积累可复用经验。本文综述了 self-evolving coding agents 这一新兴方向，即智能体能够基于过往编程交互更新自身框架、记忆、技能、工具、模型或协作结构，从而改善未来行为。论文首先定义 self-evolving coding agents，并将其与传统 coding agents 和通用 self-evolving agents 区分开；随后提出以“进化对象”为中心的分类体系，刻画系统中究竟哪些部分会发生演化，并进一步从“何时进化”和“由哪些软件特定证据驱动进化”两个正交视角进行补充。综述指出，可执行反馈、仓库级上下文和编程轨迹使软件工程成为智能体自进化的天然场景，但同时也带来反馈可靠性、基准过拟合、安全性、可维护性、成本和泛化等挑战。本文通过系统组织相关工作，旨在澄清 self-evolving coding agents 的概念边界，并为构建更自适应、可靠且具备软件感知能力的智能体系统提供基础。
key_points_zh: 论文聚焦 self-evolving coding agents：这类智能体能从历史编程交互中学习，并更新自身框架、记忆、技能、工具、模型或协作结构。
作者明确区分了 self-evolving coding agents、传统 coding agents 与通用 self-evolving agents，强调软件工程场景中可执行反馈和仓库上下文的独特性。
提出以“进化对象”为核心的 taxonomy，并结合“何时进化”和“由何种软件证据驱动进化”两个维度系统梳理已有研究。
论文指出软件工程为智能体自进化提供了天然反馈信号，如测试结果、调试轨迹、补丁成败和 repository-level context。
主要挑战包括反馈可靠性、benchmark overfitting、安全风险、长期可维护性、计算与调用成本，以及跨仓库和跨任务泛化能力。

llm_assessment.comment: As a survey, it is highly relevant for organizing self-evolving coding agents around traces, feedback, memory, skills, and framework updates.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 作为综述，它围绕轨迹、反馈、记忆、技能和框架更新系统梳理自进化编程智能体，相关性很高。
